candidate.title: Guest-email blacklist is case-sensitive, bypassing the filter
candidate.description: Blacklist is lowercased but comparison is case-sensitive, allowing uppercase variants (e.g., Spam@Evil.com) to bypass the filter and be added as attendees.

gold.title: The logic for checking team admin/owner permissions is incorrect. This condition uses AND (&&) which requires both isTea
gold.description: The logic for checking team admin/owner permissions is incorrect. This condition uses AND (&&) which requires both isTeamAdmin AND isTeamOwner to be true, but it should use OR (||) since a user needs to be either an admin OR an owner to have permission.

candidate.title: isTeamAdminOrOwner uses && which reduces to owner-only
candidate.description: ANDing isTeamAdmin (ADMIN or OWNER) with isTeamOwner (OWNER only) narrows the result to OWNER, contradicting the variable name and blocking team admins.

gold.title: This calls the email sender with the original guests, so existing attendees included in the input will be treated as new
gold.description: This calls the email sender with the original guests, so existing attendees included in the input will be treated as new when sending notifications, leading to incorrect emails.

candidate.title: Existing attendees get fresh scheduled invite instead of add-guests notice
candidate.description: Handler passes raw guests input instead of filtered uniqueGuests, so already-invited attendees are matched and re-sent full AttendeeScheduledEmail with REQUEST ICS instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail.

gold.title: uniqueGuests filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails but does not deduplicate duplicates within the input;
gold.description: uniqueGuests filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails but does not deduplicate duplicates within the input; createMany can insert duplicate attendee rows if the client submits repeated emails.

candidate.title: Server schema doesn't enforce uniqueness its error message claims
candidate.description: Uniqueness is validated only client-side. Direct tRPC calls with duplicate emails pass validation and create multiple identical attendee rows with duplicate invites.

missed_correctness_gold.title: Starting with an array containing an empty string may cause validation issues. Consider starting with an empty array []
missed_correctness_gold.description: Starting with an array containing an empty string may cause validation issues. Consider starting with an empty array [] and handling the empty state in the MultiEmail component instead.

promotion_candidates.title: Adding guests bypasses the "seats disable guests" invariant and inflates seat counts
promotion_candidates.description: New endpoint has no seatsPerTimeSlot guard, allowing attendees to create unlimited attendee rows on seated bookings. Over-capacity is then reported immediately, and new rows have no BookingSeat so guests cannot cancel.

promotion_candidates.title: you_do_not_have_permission translation key is missing
promotion_candidates.description: The error key was not added to locales/en/common.json, so unauthorized users see the raw key "you_do_not_have_permission" instead of a translated message.

promotion_candidates.title: isInvalidEmail is never cleared except on Cancel
promotion_candidates.description: After a failed validation, the error flag persists after successful submission or dismissal via Esc/overlay, showing stale error state when the dialog is reopened.
